order_note: No release-engine predecessor and no ordering constraint. SQL 130 replaces consume_financial_totp_rate_limit(uuid, text, integer, integer), created on the AWS databases from aws/migrations/proposed/NOT_APPLIED_20260911_financial_totp_enrollment.sql (on no release key), and supersedes SQL 129, which is retired and was never applied. The spec prerequisites are the function, financial_totp_rate_limits with the columns the body writes, and role checksops; a read-only production inspect confirms them. The replaced function must be owned by the applying login (functions_owned_by_login), keep its TABLE result (function_results_match) and hold no EXECUTE grant other than PUBLIC, checksops and the owner (function_acl_replaceable: PUBLIC is the one the file revokes). The file revokes EXECUTE from PUBLIC and grants it to checksops (already granted), so the ACL after the apply is checksops and the owner. The API change that sends 'code_check' (finding 7, auth-financial-totp.mjs and checkalt-register.mjs) is already live and calls as checksops; this pin only makes the database accept it. No API, Lambda or SPA change is part of this pin. Adds no trigger.
